name: Lemon

low.description: Juice of 1 lemon or zest freely

siboNotes: Lemon is excellent for SIBO cooking - both juice and zest are low FODMAP. Use freely to add flavor to dishes, dressings, and water. Great garlic/onion flavor replacement strategy.
preparationTips: Use juice for dressings and marinades
Zest adds bright flavor to dishes
